sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hell on Earth - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Warrior! Remember the DB you were building? I couldn't deliver it past the border. That's a bummer, the shotty is gorgeous. Speaking of, we've got plenty of demons of our own in Tarkov. Can't even take a shit in the woods at night! Why don't you take this gun out for a spin and deal with those devils?"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 2 hooded men while using the double barrel shotgun

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenade
- 3× RGN hand grenade
- 3× RGO hand grenade
"How'd it go? We really should add something like that to the inventory... I think it's gonna be a big hit!"

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount |
| MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun | 1 |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement |
| MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun | As many as needed | Used by the player to eliminate Cultists. |
| MP-43 12ga sawed-off double-barrel shotgun | As many as needed | Used by the player to eliminate Cultists. |
In this quest you have to kill 3 Cultists with a MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun or MP-43 12ga sawed-off double-barrel shotgun. It can be in any configuration.
